title: Gift recommendation and wishlist
summary: Never buy a bad gift again: wishlists and smart gift suggestions.
whyTempting: Gift-giving is stressful and high-intent shopping.
whyItFails: Seasonal usage. Activity spikes at Christmas and birthdays, then dies. Thin affiliate margins. Monetisation relies on small commissions. Amazon wishlists exist. Incumbents cover the basics.
whatWouldChange: Strong taste-graph data plus AI that genuinely knows the recipient.

attempts.notes: Social shopping and wish lists; about 11 million registered users by 2014, user data stolen in a 2019 hack.
